ayahs.ar: قُلۡ اُوۡحِيَ اِلَيَّ اَنَّهُ اسۡتَمَعَ نَفَرٌ مِّنَ الۡجِنِّ فَقَالُوۡ٘ا اِنَّا سَمِعۡنَا قُرۡاٰنًا عَجَبًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Qul oohiya ilaiya annna hustama'a nafarum minal jinnni faqaalooo innaa sami'naa quraanan 'ajabaa
ayahs.en: Say, [O Muhammad], "It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, 'Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur'an.

ayahs.ar: يَّهۡدِيۡ٘ اِلَي الرُّشۡدِ فَاٰمَنَّا بِهٖؕ وَلَنۡ نُّشۡرِكَ بِرَبِّنَا٘ اَحَدًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Yahdeee ilar rushdi fa aamannaa bihee wa lan nushrika bi rabbinaaa ahadaa
ayahs.en: It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone.

ayahs.ar: وَّاَنَّهٗ تَعٰلٰي جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا اتَّخَذَ صَاحِبَةً وَّلَا وَلَدًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa annahoo Ta'aalaa jaddu Rabbinaa mat takhaza saahibatanw wa la waladaa
ayahs.en: And [it teaches] that exalted is the nobleness of our Lord; He has not taken a wife or a son

ayahs.ar: وَّاَنَّهٗ كَانَ يَقُوۡلُ سَفِيۡهُنَا عَلَي اللّٰهِ شَطَطًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa annahoo kaana yaqoolu safeehunaa 'alal laahi shatataa
ayahs.en: And that our foolish one has been saying about Allah an excessive transgression.

ayahs.ar: وَّاَنَّا ظَنَنَّا٘ اَنۡ لَّنۡ تَقُوۡلَ الۡاِنۡسُ وَالۡجِنُّ عَلَي اللّٰهِ كَذِبًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa annaa zanannaaa al lan taqoolal insu wal jinnu 'alal laahi kazibaa
ayahs.en: And we had thought that mankind and the jinn would never speak about Allah a lie.

ayahs.ar: وَّاَنَّهٗ كَانَ رِجَالٌ مِّنَ الۡاِنۡسِ يَعُوۡذُوۡنَ بِرِجَالٍ مِّنَ الۡجِنِّ فَزَادُوۡهُمۡ رَهَقًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa annahoo kaana rijaa lum minal insi ya'oozoona birijaalim minal jinni fazaa doohum rahaqaa
ayahs.en: And there were men from mankind who sought refuge in men from the jinn, so they [only] increased them in burden.

ayahs.ar: وَّاَنَّهُمۡ ظَنُّوۡا كَمَا ظَنَنۡتُمۡ اَنۡ لَّنۡ يَّبۡعَثَ اللّٰهُ اَحَدًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa annahum zannoo kamaa zanantum al lany yab'asal laahu ahadaa
ayahs.en: And they had thought, as you thought, that Allah would never send anyone [as a messenger].

ayahs.ar: وَّاَنَّا لَمَسۡنَا السَّمَآءَ فَوَجَدۡنٰهَا مُلِئَتۡ حَرَسًا شَدِيۡدًا وَّشُهُبًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa annaa lamasnas sa maaa'a fa wajadnaahaa muli'at harasan shadeedanw wa shuhubaa
ayahs.en: And we have sought [to reach] the heaven but found it filled with powerful guards and burning flames.

ayahs.ar: وَّاَنَّا كُنَّا نَقۡعُدُ مِنۡهَا مَقَاعِدَ لِلسَّمۡعِؕ فَمَنۡ يَّسۡتَمِعِ الۡاٰنَ يَجِدۡ لَهٗ شِهَابًا رَّصَدًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa annaa kunnaa naq'udu minhaa maqaa'ida lis'sam'i famany yastami'il aana yajid lahoo shihaabar rasada
ayahs.en: And we used to sit therein in positions for hearing, but whoever listens now will find a burning flame lying in wait for him.

ayahs.ar: وَّاَنَّا لَا نَدۡرِيۡ٘ اَشَرٌّ اُرِيۡدَ بِمَنۡ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ اَمۡ اَرَادَ بِهِمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ رَشَدًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa annaa laa nadreee asharrun ureeda biman fil ardi am araada bihim rabbuhum rashadaa
ayahs.en: And we do not know [therefore] whether evil is intended for those on earth or whether their Lord intends for them a right course.

ayahs.ar: وَّاَنَّا مِنَّا الصّٰلِحُوۡنَ وَمِنَّا دُوۡنَ ذٰلِكَؕ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa annaa minnas saalihoona wa minnaa doona zaalika kunnaa taraaa'ilqa qidadaa
ayahs.en: And among us are the righteous, and among us are [others] not so; we were [of] divided ways.

ayahs.ar: وَّاَنَّا ظَنَنَّا٘ اَنۡ لَّنۡ نُّعۡجِزَ اللّٰهَ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ وَلَنۡ نُّعۡجِزَهٗ هَرَبًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa annaa zanannaaa al lan nu'jizal laaha fil ardi wa lan nu'jizahoo harabaa
ayahs.en: And we have become certain that we will never cause failure to Allah upon earth, nor can we escape Him by flight.

ayahs.ar: وَّاَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعۡنَا الۡهُدٰ٘ي اٰمَنَّا بِهٖؕ فَمَنۡ يُّؤۡمِنۭۡ بِرَبِّهٖ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخۡسًا وَّلَا رَهَقًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa annaa lammaa sami'nal hudaaa aamannaa bihee famany yu'mim bi rabbihee falaa yakhaafu bakhsanw wa laa rahaqaa
ayahs.en: And when we heard the guidance, we believed in it. And whoever believes in his Lord will not fear deprivation or burden.

ayahs.ar: وَّاَنَّا مِنَّا الۡمُسۡلِمُوۡنَ وَمِنَّا الۡقٰسِطُوۡنَؕ فَمَنۡ اَسۡلَمَ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ تَحَرَّوۡا رَشَدًا
ayahs.tl: Wa annaa minnal muslimoona wa minnal qaasitoona faman aslama fa ulaaa'ika taharraw rashadaa
ayahs.en: And among us are Muslims [in submission to Allah], and among us are the unjust. And whoever has become Muslim - those have sought out the right course.

ayahs.ar: وَاَمَّا الۡقٰسِطُوۡنَ فَكَانُوۡا لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa ammal qaasitoona fa kaanoo li jahannama hatabaa
ayahs.en: But as for the unjust, they will be, for Hell, firewood.'

ayahs.ar: وَّاَنۡ لَّوِ اسۡتَقَامُوۡا عَلَي الطَّرِيۡقَةِ لَاَسۡقَيۡنٰهُمۡ مَّآءً غَدَقًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa alla wis taqaamoo 'alat tareeqati la asqaynaahum maa'an ghadaqaa
ayahs.en: And [Allah revealed] that if they had remained straight on the way, We would have given them abundant provision

ayahs.ar: لِّنَفۡتِنَهُمۡ فِيۡهِؕ وَمَنۡ يُّعۡرِضۡ عَنۡ ذِكۡرِ رَبِّهٖ يَسۡلُكۡهُ عَذَابًا صَعَدًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Linaftinahum feeh; wa many yu'rid 'an zikri rabbihee yasluk hu 'azaaban sa'adaa
ayahs.en: So We might test them therein. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord He will put into arduous punishment.

ayahs.ar: وَّاَنَّ الۡمَسٰجِدَ لِلّٰهِ فَلَا تَدۡعُوۡا مَعَ اللّٰهِ اَحَدًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa annal masaajida lillaahi falaa tad'oo ma'al laahi ahadaa
ayahs.en: And [He revealed] that the masjids are for Allah, so do not invoke with Allah anyone.

ayahs.ar: وَّاَنَّهٗ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبۡدُ اللّٰهِ يَدۡعُوۡهُ كَادُوۡا يَكُوۡنُوۡنَ عَلَيۡهِ لِبَدًاؕࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa annahoo lammaa qaama 'adul laahi yad'oohu kaadoo yakoonoona 'alaihi libadaa
ayahs.en: And that when the Servant of Allah stood up supplicating Him, they almost became about him a compacted mass."

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ اِنَّمَا٘ اَدۡعُوۡا رَبِّيۡ وَلَا٘ اُشۡرِكُ بِهٖ٘ اَحَدًا
ayahs.tl: Qul innamaaa ad'oo rabbee wa laaa ushriku biheee ahadaa
ayahs.en: Say, [O Muhammad], "I only invoke my Lord and do not associate with Him anyone."

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ اِنِّيۡ لَا٘ اَمۡلِكُ لَكُمۡ ضَرًّا وَّلَا رَشَدًا
ayahs.tl: Qul innee laaa amliku lakum darranw wa laa rashadaa
ayahs.en: Say, "Indeed, I do not possess for you [the power of] harm or right direction."

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ اِنِّيۡ لَنۡ يُّجِيۡرَنِيۡ مِنَ اللّٰهِ اَحَدٌ ࣢ۙ وَّلَنۡ اَجِدَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ مُلۡتَحَدًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Qul innee lany yujeeranee minal laahi ahad, wa lan ajida min doonihee multahadaa
ayahs.en: Say, "Indeed, there will never protect me from Allah anyone [if I should disobey], nor will I find in other than Him a refuge.

ayahs.ar: اِلَّا بَلٰغًا مِّنَ اللّٰهِ وَرِسٰلٰتِهٖؕ وَمَنۡ يَّعۡصِ اللّٰهَ وَرَسُوۡلَهٗ فَاِنَّ لَهٗ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خٰلِدِيۡنَ فِيۡهَا٘ اَبَدًاؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Illaa balaagham minal laahi wa risaalaatih; wa many ya'sil laaha wa rasoolahoo fa inna lahoo naara jahannama khaalideena feehaaa abadaa
ayahs.en: But [I have for you] only notification from Allah, and His messages." And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger - then indeed, for him is the fire of Hell; they will abide therein forever.

ayahs.ar: حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا رَاَوۡا مَا يُوۡعَدُوۡنَ فَسَيَعۡلَمُوۡنَ مَنۡ اَضۡعَفُ نَاصِرًا وَّاَقَلُّ عَدَدًا
ayahs.tl: Hattaaa izaa ra aw maa yoo'adoona fasaya'lamoona man ad'afu naasiranw wa aqallu 'adadaa
ayahs.en: [The disbelievers continue] until, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who is weaker in helpers and less in number.

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ اِنۡ اَدۡرِيۡ٘ اَقَرِيۡبٌ مَّا تُوۡعَدُوۡنَ اَمۡ يَجۡعَلُ لَهٗ رَبِّيۡ٘ اَمَدًا
ayahs.tl: Qul in adreee a qareebum maa too'adoona am yaj'alu lahoo rabbeee amadaa
ayahs.en: Say, "I do not know if what you are promised is near or if my Lord will grant for it a [long] period."

ayahs.ar: عٰلِمُ الۡغَيۡبِ فَلَا يُظۡهِرُ عَلٰي غَيۡبِهٖ٘ اَحَدًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: 'Aalimul ghaibi falaa yuzhiru alaa ghaibiheee ahadaa
ayahs.en: [He is] Knower of the unseen, and He does not disclose His [knowledge of the] unseen to anyone

ayahs.ar: اِلَّا مَنِ ارۡتَضٰي مِنۡ رَّسُوۡلٍ فَاِنَّهٗ يَسۡلُكُ مِنۭۡ بَيۡنِ يَدَيۡهِ وَمِنۡ خَلۡفِهٖ رَصَدًاۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Illaa manir tadaa mir rasoolin fa innahoo yasluku mim baini yadihi wa min khalfihee rasadaa
ayahs.en: Except whom He has approved of messengers, and indeed, He sends before each messenger and behind him observers

ayahs.ar: لِّيَعۡلَمَ اَنۡ قَدۡ اَبۡلَغُوۡا رِسٰلٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ وَاَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيۡهِمۡ وَاَحۡصٰي كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ عَدَدًاࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Liya'lama an qad ablaghoo risaalaati rabbihim wa ahaata bima ladihim wa ahsaa kulla shai'in 'adadaa
ayahs.en: That he may know that they have conveyed the messages of their Lord; and He has encompassed whatever is with them and has enumerated all things in number.
